rencontre.glace1: What's the last thing that made you laugh out loud on your own in the street?
rencontre.glace2: If someone read your search history from the last three days, what would they work out about you?
rencontre.glace3: Are you the type to turn up twenty minutes early or to run the last five minutes?
rencontre.glace4: What's the most useless thing you can do perfectly?
rencontre.glace5: Which dish takes you straight back to being a child?
rencontre.glace6: What have you rewatched on a loop at some point without ever admitting it?
rencontre.glace7: Do you prefer an evening where everything is planned or one where nothing is?
rencontre.glace8: What's your smallest win of the week?
rencontre.glace9: Is there a place you always go back to when you need to clear your head?
rencontre.glace10: What puts you in a bad mood far more than it reasonably should?
rencontre.glace11: What's the best completely useless piece of advice you've been given?
rencontre.glace12: If you had to leave for three months tomorrow, where would it be, and why there?
rencontre.glace13: Have you kept some worthless object you'll never throw away?
rencontre.glace14: Which song do you know by heart without ever having chosen it?
rencontre.glace15: What's your perfect Sunday, hour by hour?
rencontre.glace16: What do people assume about you when they meet you that's wrong?
rencontre.glace17: Do you finish the books you start, or do you have twelve on the go?
rencontre.glace18: What talent would you like to have without ever having wanted to learn it?
rencontre.glace19: What's the most ridiculous spending habit you fully stand by?
rencontre.glace20: If your week had a soundtrack, what kind of music would it be?
rencontre.connaitre1: What have you learned about yourself this year?
rencontre.connaitre2: What decision did you make that nobody around you understood?
rencontre.connaitre3: Who influenced you the most without ever knowing it?
rencontre.connaitre4: What do you do when things are bad and nobody can tell?
rencontre.connaitre5: What are you proudest of and never talk about?
rencontre.connaitre6: Is there a friendship you let fade that you regret?
rencontre.connaitre7: What makes you immediately uncomfortable in someone?
rencontre.connaitre8: Who were you at twenty, and what has changed since?
rencontre.connaitre9: What have you stopped doing to please other people?
rencontre.connaitre10: Which compliment genuinely reaches you, and which one leaves you cold?
rencontre.connaitre11: What do you expect from someone in the first six months?
rencontre.connaitre12: How do you react when someone lets you down?
rencontre.connaitre13: What did your family pass on that you keep, and what did you decide not to repeat?
rencontre.connaitre14: What makes you stay somewhere: in a job, in a city, with someone?
rencontre.connaitre15: What's the most generous thing anyone has done for you?
rencontre.connaitre16: Do you prefer to be told things straight away, or to wait for the right moment?
rencontre.connaitre17: What would you struggle to forgive?
rencontre.connaitre18: What does your life look like in five years if everything goes well?
rencontre.connaitre19: What do you do with your time when you have absolutely nothing to do?
rencontre.connaitre20: What are you looking for right now, even if you can't quite put it into words?
rencontre.loin1: What have you already noticed about me since this conversation started?
rencontre.loin2: What would you like people to know about you without having to explain it?
rencontre.loin3: What are you most afraid of, apart from the obvious things?
rencontre.loin4: What have you never told anyone, simply because the moment never came?
rencontre.loin5: What do you most regret not having said to someone?
rencontre.loin6: What would make you feel genuinely safe with someone?
rencontre.loin7: When did you last feel lonely, and where were you?
rencontre.loin8: What have you not managed to forgive yourself for?
rencontre.loin9: If you found out you had a year left, what would you change tomorrow?
rencontre.loin10: What would you want to hear from someone who loves you?
rencontre.loin11: What is it about you that makes people leave, in your opinion?
rencontre.loin12: When did you last cry, and why?
rencontre.loin13: What do you want from me, right now, honestly?
rencontre.loin14: What can't you bring yourself to ask for, even when you need it?
rencontre.loin15: Is there someone you think about often and will never see again?
rencontre.loin16: What would you change about yourself that you've never managed to change?
rencontre.loin17: What do you miss most, right now?
rencontre.loin18: What would you say to me if you knew we'd never see each other again?
rencontre.loin19: What's the truest thing you can say about yourself in one sentence?
rencontre.loin20: What would you like me to give you my honest opinion on?
rencontre.theme_connaitre: To actually get to know each other
rencontre.desc_glace: We start light. The point of this level isn't to learn things, it's to get into the habit of answering for real.
rencontre.desc_connaitre: Now to what built you. You give something of yourself, without it costing anything yet.
rencontre.desc_loin: The level that changes everything. Answer if you want to, never because the question was asked.
rencontre.setupTitre: Ready to ask each other the right questions?
rencontre.setupDesc: Fifteen questions, three increasingly personal levels. You both answer every one, out loud, in turn.
rencontre.consigne: Both of you answer, in turn. Whoever goes second doesn't get to say « same ».
rencontre.finTitre: You've been through all three levels
rencontre.finTexte: The interesting part starts now: what you keep talking about without a phone prompting you.
